sticker-workshop-combined.prompt:
Make one crop-ready transparent 3-by-3 asset atlas for an original first-grade sticker workshop classroom. Landscape 1536×1024 composition. Exactly three equal columns and three equal rows, one independent asset centered within each cell, at least 6% transparent margins on all four sides of each cell. Keep all cells separate and their art fully visible. Use genuine transparent alpha in all negative space, never a checkerboard. No labels, words, digits, letters, logos, frames around the atlas, or watermarks. 

Unify the artwork with subtle paper grain, matte gouache, crisp cut-paper silhouettes, deep pine greens, warm cream, light apricot, persimmon accents. Calm larger color shapes, legible on a small screen. Any narrative panel is a separate, straight-edged 16:9 art rectangle on the transparent atlas. Educational counting objects and grids will be drawn separately.

Row 1 col 1: One wide 16:9 narrative art rectangle. Two first-grade children at a low Chinese school sticker workshop desk, a girl with a black bob and apricot sweater, and a boy with short dark hair and pine-green top. They look with interest at a largely empty plain wood tray on the table. Warm paper light, quiet friendly faces, visible at small scale. No scattered counting objects.
Row 1 col 2: One wide 16:9 backdrop art rectangle. An empty indoor sticker workshop at standing eye level, with gentle pale apricot wall and very quiet pale wood central floor; pine cabinets at far outside edges and mostly negative space in the middle for falling-block game graphics. No people or loose props.
Row 1 col 3: One wide 16:9 backdrop art rectangle. Front-view craft stockroom at a Chinese elementary school, a distinct green-and-warm-cream room with shelves only along the far edges and a quiet open cream floor; clear empty center and no people, equipment, carts, or loose props.
Row 2 col 1: One wide 16:9 narrative art rectangle. The same bob-haired girl in apricot brings a plain tray to show her smiling parent at home near a softly lit paper-cream window. No contents on the tray, no words or digits.
Row 2 col 2: One isolated simple yellow wooden push cart with exactly two pine-green wheels, clear right-facing side profile and low shallow empty tray. A tiny warm cream accent. Center it and keep the whole cart fully visible.
Row 2 col 3: The same right-facing yellow wooden push cart in a second animation pose, very slightly tipped forward with the same two dark pine wheels and tray; tiny muted dust puff stays beside wheels, whole silhouette intact.
Row 3 col 1: One small leaf-shaped craft achievement badge with warm cream trim, muted green and light apricot, clean silhouette, no lettering.
Row 3 col 2: One single open picture book, seen nearly straight overhead, dark pine cover and pale cream blank pages, broad clean horizontal book, perfectly legible outside boundary. Keep the right page lower corner flat, empty, and pale so a page number can be overlaid later. Do not print a page number, text, or illustration.
Row 3 col 3: One single orange-and-warm-cream paper rosette sticker achievement, little folded ribbons below, no lettering or number.
